$comment: Citation registry for the assessment matrix and pathway descriptions. Keys here are the only valid values for any 'references' array in matrix.json or pathways.json. Mirrors the bibliography of González-Espinoza (2026); reference numbers in [brackets] match the source paper. Entries carrying 'source': 'materials-guidance' are cited by the Pathway-C materials sub-domain and are not in the paper's bibliography — they have no 'ref' number and sort after it in the rendered list.
